text:
Carla Nguyen: heads up — seeing a spike in invoke fncall validation rejects for the payments workflow. many are being sent to the degen route, but console sampling shows 0 examples. can we escalate? :confused:
Ben Ortiz: which region / model variant?
Carla Nguyen: eu-west1, model: t4-small-v2 (hosted). logs show `validate_fncall: missing required field 'action.payload'` and route=degen reason=validation_reject
Alice Park: is this from the new strict-schema rollout? timeline?
Carla Nguyen: started ~09:12 UTC after canary toggles. think strict-validate v2 went live.
Dan Li: dashboard currently aggregates rejects but sampling job has bug — its SQL uses `route='tool'` not `route='degen'` so samples never join. opened PR: #8214
Emily Reed: UX request — when a request is routed to degen we should surface a reason badge and link to sample in the route details. customers ask "why did my call fail"
Ben Ortiz: agree. ops side — also worry about quota attribution: degen traffic shouldn't count against committed throughput. are we double-counting?
Dan Li: looks like billing tags are preserved but the metering pipeline drops `route_id` for validation rejects. tracking in #8216
Carla Nguyen: can we get a short-term mitigation? maybe route degen to fallback that returns an explanatory toolcall error and surface that in the response
Alice Park: can do. will add header `x-redwood-fn-reject: validation:action.payload` in fallback. also will add a quick dashboard panel to surface reject-count-by-route
ops-bot: deploy started: canary strict-validate-v2 -> 3 hosts (id: c-1702). ETA 3m
Ben Ortiz: thanks team. Dan + Alice, can you sync and post a followup with links to PRs and dashboard ticket? i'll loop in Billing if we confirm double-count
Carla Nguyen: TY! I'm attaching a sample log below:
```
2026-01-12T09:12:33Z invoke_id=abc123 route=degen model=t4-small-v2 error=validate_fncall missing 'action.payload' quota_tag=dedicated-123
```
Emily Reed: tagging product-request: show reject reason in console flyout + quick "how to fix" steps
Dan Li: PRs: 8214 (sampling fix), 8216 (metering route fix). dashboard ticket: RD-1457
Ben Ortiz: marking this as high priority, will monitor metrics and revert canary if trend worsens :thumbsup:
Carla Nguyen: closing loop — will post results in 1h.
